_notes.selection: the eval bin requires the recipient's own answer wrong and the donor's right: it favours the donor in donor-minus-SELF; 'all eval items' and 'donor-right items' are printed without that selection
_notes.scope: the self-map reads the recipient's layer-L_R state at the graft position; it bounds what this map recipe extracts from the recipient alone, not everything the recipient could compute

unselected_extra.what: donor map minus self-map on the eval bin, every eval item, and the donor-right items; seed 0 vs seed 0 (these donor maps have one seed), plus the SELF seed-mean for the linear maps; descriptive

at_3k.what: maps trained on the original 3,000 problems only (same recipe, items, order and seeds as the 3,000-problem run); donor map minus SELF on the same eval bin; descriptive
